alter table public.assets drop constraint assets_subject_shape;
alter table public.assets add constraint assets_subject_shape check ((subject = 'property' and property_id is not null and brand_key is null) or (subject = 'brand' and property_id is null and brand_key ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'));
run: bunx vitest run --project db tests/db/brand-subject.db.test.ts -t "needs a well-formed key and no property"
expect: × .*needs a well-formed key and no property

run: bunx vitest run --project db tests/db/brand-subject.db.test.ts -t "is one per key, kind and revision"
expect: × .*is one per key, kind and revision
